market_question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (LOW) $40 by end of June?
reasoning: Crude Oil at $61 requires a ~34% decline to reach a $40 settlement. Given ~35% implied volatility and 13 months to expiry, a discrete barrier model suggests a ~25% probability of touching $40 at settlement, historically supported by episodes in 2016 and 2020. The market's 1.1% implied probability drastically undervalues this tail risk.
evidence_points: CL touch barrier probability using lognormal model with daily monitoring ≈ 25%
Historical sub-$40 settlements occurred in 2015-16 and 2020
Current macro and geopolitical uncertainties amplify downside tail risk
